movingGuideSurfaceExceptions: annular runner versus eight telescopic sleeves: intentional carriage attachment

independentPanelFlips.method: Exact full-revolution Rodrigues coordinate extrema of actual loaded body/morph and all constructed cap/core mesh vertices; all landing quarters, both morph endpoints, all cap profiles; separating support intervals in 16 planar directions
independentPanelFlips.scope: Panel-to-panel poses only. Static source/carrier/guide gates remain separately audited and require full deployment.

normalRippleTravel.scope: V17 Deploy=1 source/mechanism screen for extra card-center face-normal travel ±25mm plus same-normal ±6mm tilt-edge budget. Twelve outer square cards, six neutral/clicked depth/offset cases, four axes, 0..180 degrees at 15-degree steps, face headings 0/45/90/135. Source/cube, fixed mount/stator/spokes, runner proxy and moving rim. Includes four corner bodies and all four nubs per corner at 15-degree flips. BVH at -31/0/+31mm wherever the full swept AABB overlaps an obstacle. Swept-box candidates can still collide between those BVH samples. No simultaneous panels or continuous flip/heading certificate.
normalRippleTravel.limitation: Sampled source/mechanism screen, not continuous source clearance. Center translation is face-normal and leaves the continuous card-pair planar separating intervals unchanged; tilt retains its 6mm point budget.
